scope: Standard-codec Macintosh Japanese/Traditional Chinese/Korean/Simplified Chinese name records; no glyph or shaping changes
implementation: Python standard-library x_mac_japanese/x_mac_trad_chinese/x_mac_korean/x_mac_simp_chinese codecs; no copied translation tables or codec registration
oracle: fontTools 4.66.1 TTFont name.getDebugName and complete FontFace metadata

checks.skip_reason: Real POSIX fork is unavailable on Windows; cache child-reset behavior is checked separately
checks.font_regression_selection: All tests/**/*.py filenames containing font, sfnt, fvar or ligature; not a new full-project regression
checks.repertoire: Every strictly decodable non-NUL one/two-byte unit per codec, separator-delimited in bounded name records, all IDs 1/4/6/16; results equal engine with fontTools import forbidden during native reads
checks.full_face: Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Simplified Chinese owned font fixtures match engine FontFace with fontTools import forbidden; source bytes unchanged
checks.fallback: Macintosh extension bytes unsupported by standard codecs preserve engine results and invoke the existing fallback
checks.cjk_limits_and_cancellation: Repeated CJK name bytes exhaust the native work quota; cancellation between records propagates without engine fallback

limits: Existing 32 MiB sfnt input, 4096 name records/language-tag records, 8 MiB repeated decoded-byte work and cancellation checkpoints unchanged; third-party fallback is not bounded by these quotas
remaining: Macintosh extension/recovery profiles, compressed wrappers and unsupported metadata retain fontTools; real subsetting still requires the optional engine. No general fontTools removal or universal fidelity claim.
